name: What's for Dinner?
tagline: One home-cooked dinner proposal a day, matched to your household
description: It learns your household's allergies, diets, kitchen gear and budget, then proposes one home-cooked dinner each day instead of burying you in options. Standing in front of a half-empty fridge at six o'clock? Tell it what is left and it will rebuild tonight's meal around that.
author: CantBeatDees
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
